notes:
A large, slow-moving mass of ice formed from compacted snow on mountains or near the poles. Composed of {氷|ひょう} (ice) and {河|が} (river). Frequently appears in climate change discussions and geography.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {氷河|ひょうが}{期|き}: ice age, glacial period
- {氷河|ひょうが}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{溶|と}ける→溶ける：02302_tokeru⟧: a glacier melts
- {氷河|ひょうが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{融解|ゆうかい}→融解：08404_yuukai⟧: glacial melting
- {氷河|ひょうが}⟦{地形|ちけい}→地形：12083_chikei⟧: glacial landform

CULTURAL NOTE:
{就職|しゅうしょく}{氷河|ひょうが}{期|き} (employment ice age) is a well-known expression for periods of extreme difficulty in finding jobs, originally referring to the economic downturn after Japan's bubble economy burst in the 1990s.
